channel.title: Daybrief
channel.description: AI first. Everything else that matters, twice a day.

item.title: JetBrains/thinkrail: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You…
item.description: ThinkRail is an agentic IDE built around the pi coding agent, isolating agent work in separate git-worktree workspaces with living specs and reusable skills. It has 2,336 GitHub stars, 1,156 of them today. Why it matters: JetBrains-published tool for running AI coding agents in parallel, each in its own git workspace.

item.title: Jamus Lim responds to PM Wong's criticisms that WP 'shifts with the political winds', Petir responds in turn
item.description: WP MP Jamus Lim called PM Wong's criticism of the party a 'double standard'; PAP's Petir then criticised Lim.

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon: The Model and Safety Cards
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon's model and safety cards show it is much stronger than Gemini Flash 3.8 and raises no major danger alarms.

item.title: 953 Online Stores Infected in Long-Lasting Malware Campaign
item.description: Sansec reports a threat actor infected 953 online stores, most running Magento, with JavaScript loader code since July 2025.

item.title: Google AI Pro upgrades are turning into a costly headache for some students
item.description: Students who upgraded from free Google AI Plus to discounted AI Pro report unexpected cancellations and refunds, leaving them without either plan.

item.title: Oracle unveils AI agents for business applications
Meta announces $95 billion stock offering to fund AI expansion
item.description: Meta plans to raise $95 billion for AI infrastructure and superintelligence, with Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom eyeing up to $5 billion in shares.

item.title: iFast Q3 profit rises 24.5% to S$32 million on overall revenue growth
item.description: Digital bank and wealth platform iFast reported a 24.5% rise in Q3 net profit to S$32.4 million, with revenue up 23% to S$167 million.

item.title: Europe can still shape the rules of AI
item.description: An op-ed argues the EU can use its regulatory weight to influence how AI systems are tested and deployed.

item.title: Meta announces a major financing plan of up to US$95 billion to fund AI and other businesses
item.description: Meta announced a financing plan of up to US$95 billion to fund its core business and AI initiatives.

item.title: Google DeepMind's AI hurricane forecasting model outperformed conventional models by accurately predicting that Hurricane Isaias would make landfall in Florida
item.description: Google DeepMind's AI model correctly predicted that Hurricane Isaias would hit the Florida Panhandle, while conventional models initially forecast Louisiana.

item.title: TeleChoice unit secures S$1.3 billion supply chain deal from Malaysia’s U Mobile
item.description: TeleChoice International has won a renewed contract with Malaysia's U Mobile worth around S$1.3 billion. The three-year deal, with an option to extend two more years, is expected to boost earnings from FY2027. Why it matters: A large Singapore-listed contract tied to Malaysia's telecom sector, relevant to Southeast Asia business readers.

item.title: Cracking AI trade has Wall Street looking for a hedge. An ex-Citadel quant may have the answer
item.description: Hyperbolic, led by an ex-Citadel quant, is building a spot marketplace for trading GPU computing power as a possible hedge against falling AI demand.

item.title: SpaceX enters $40 billion deal with Apollo for AI chip financing
item.description: SpaceX has agreed to a deal with Apollo, in which an Apollo affiliate will buy AI chips and server hardware and lease them to SpaceX, with total principal payments of about $40 billion. The leases are expected to start in the first half of 2027, once the chips are delivered. Why it matters: Shows how large AI compute buildouts are being financed through leasing deals rather than outright purchases.

item.title: Singapore stocks close lower amid mixed regional showing; STI down 0.1%
item.description: The Straits Times Index lost 0.1% to close at 5,415.91 on Monday, Oct 26, as regional markets were mixed.

item.title: Why Reddit built its own AI prototyping tool | Blair Metcalf
item.description: Reddit's principal UX engineer Blair Metcalf explains Reddit Proto, the company's in-house vibe-coding harness. It uses a design system MCP to map Reddit's product language to production code, and has over 700 prototypes live. Why it matters: Touches AI models and AI agents.

item.title: Popular AI tool LiteLLM says unrevoked key allowed hackers to target users
item.description: LiteLLM says an exposed key that it never revoked let attackers distribute a version of its tool containing credential-harvesting malware.

item.title: A $68 million bitcoin bet is targeting a post-midterm election breakout to $90,000
item.description: A wallet bought 800 bitcoin $90,000 call options expiring Nov. 6 on Derive, worth about $68 million and the platform's largest open position.

item.title: Amoy Street accident: Woman dies in hospital after about a week; driver to be investigated
item.description: A 25-year-old woman hurt in a Chinatown three-car crash on Oct 17 has died; a driver was arrested for drink driving.

item.title: Lack of staff and funding likely led to the recent PHP security snafu; project has only one full-time employee, but that's just the tip of the iceberg
item.description: The PHP Foundation reportedly has one full-time employee and 14 mostly part-time contractors, a funding gap likely tied to a recent critical PHP flaw.

item.title: Gurman: Apple's Three-Day Announcement Run Could Start Today
item.description: Mark Gurman speculates Apple could announce products on three consecutive days this week, starting with an OLED iPad mini, though Apple has not confirmed.

item.title: Dutch Police Arrest Two Over NFC Relay Attacks That Drained $400,000+ From Bank Accounts
item.description: Dutch police arrested two people over a bank helpdesk scam that used AI-generated audio and NFC card-relay to loot €380,000 from 170 victims.

item.title: Small nuclear reactors could boost the Asean Power Grid: GE Vernova executive
item.description: Eric Gray sees Singapore, the Philippines as promising markets for deployment of these cutting-edge reactors [SINGAPORE] Nuclear power with small modular reactors (SMRs) could be a “huge strategic advantage” for…

item.title: Claude Code AI finds a cryptominer on a Mac; says it didn’t put it there
item.description: A Redditor using Claude Code to build a Mac temperature monitor found a cryptominer using over 1,000% CPU, which Claude said it did not install.

item.title: Aviva Investors, Ripple launch tokenized share class of $29 billion sterling fund on XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors has launched a tokenized share class of its $29 billion Sterling Liquidity Fund on the Ripple-backed XRP Ledger, its second such fund.

item.title: One Million Saddles: Carbon’s 3D Printed Lattices Hit Mass Production
item.description: Carbon has produced over one million 3D-printed cycling saddles with 11 brands and more than 60 models in production.

item.title: Metal 3D printing for under $5,000? Global Laser Box says hundreds have already shipped
item.description: Global Laser Box says several hundred of its $4,988 compact metal 3D printers have shipped, and its GLB-M1 crowdfunding starts late November.

item.title: GlobalFoundries turns its Singapore fabs into a test bed for an AI-run control room
item.description: GlobalFoundries is testing an AI-run control room at its Singapore fabs to tackle issues like failing chillers and gas leaks that cut output.

item.title: Meta plans to raise $95B to finance its AI infrastructure, including $35B in public equity offerings, backed by cornerstone investors Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom
item.description: Meta plans to raise $95 billion for AI infrastructure, including $35 billion in public equity offerings, with Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom as cornerstone investors.

item.title: Meta seeks up to US$95 bil in equity to fund AI spending
item.description: Meta Platforms is seeking to raise up to US$95 billion by selling common and preferred stock to fund its AI spending.

item.title: Conversion Kit Aims to Put PC Hardware Inside 2019 Mac Pro
item.description: A crowdfunded kit from Practical Prototyping lets 2019 Mac Pro owners fit an ATX motherboard and power supply into the enclosure.

item.title: Bitcoin holds near $80,000 as oil retreats and the Fed decision looms
item.description: Bitcoin held near $80,400 as oil retreated and the Fed decision due Wednesday loomed, with a 90% chance of no change per CME FedWatch.

item.title: Between alerts: What Attackers Do in the Spaces Ordinary Detection Misses
item.description: Network detection and response data can connect isolated SOC alerts into one timeline of how an attack started and progressed.

item.title: Elvis Presley's estate is suing Anthropic over copyright infringement
item.description: Elvis Presley's music estate and rights holders sued Anthropic for $41 million, alleging it trained its models on Presley songs without permission.

item.title: The public internet model is effectively dead due to saturation, algorithmic aggregators, and AI security vulnerabilities, and that may open new possibilities
item.description: An essay argues the public internet model is effectively dead due to saturation, algorithmic aggregators and AI security vulnerabilities, which may open new possibilities.

item.title: Indonesia says gas export cuts to Singapore within contractual limits, pledges to honour obligations
item.description: Indonesia says its gas export cuts to Singapore, about 8 per cent, are within contract limits and aim to divert supply to domestic electricity.

item.title: Steward Leadership 25 awards honour firms that turn social, environmental challenges into growth
item.description: Twenty-five companies in Asia and the Pacific, whose projects tackle environmental and social challenges while growing profitably, will be honoured on Oct 28.

item.title: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz to make first official visit to Singapore from Oct 27 to 28
item.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz makes his first official visit to Singapore from Oct 27 to 28, meeting Lawrence Wong.

item.title: Ray-Ban Meta Audio glasses review: no camera is a bonus for some, good audio quality, and Meta AI works well, but lingering privacy concerns and fairly pricey
item.description: A review of Meta's $349-and-up Ray-Ban Meta Audio glasses finds good audio and working Meta AI, but notes privacy concerns and a high price.

item.title: Meta to raise up to $95 billion in equity to fund costly AI expansion
item.description: Meta said it plans to raise up to $95 billion in equity, including about $35 billion in public offerings, to fund its costly AI expansion.

item.title: Bias in Qwen3-Coder Model
item.description: Research finds Qwen3-Coder produces less secure code when told the app is for a US defense contractor, 19% more likely to be hackable.

item.title: When Traction Becomes Personal Exposure: What The Joonko Guilty Plea Means For Founders
item.description: Joonko founder Ilit Raz pleaded guilty to federal securities fraud after telling investors about customers and revenue the company never had.

item.title: Nvidia RTX 20, 30, and 40-series GPUs hacked to remove a half-speed AI throttle
item.description: Modders have found a firmware exploit that removes a half-speed AI limit on Nvidia RTX 20, 30 and 40-series GPUs, using unofficial Linux modules.

item.title: Former minister Maliki Osman, Revolut chairman join Asia Gulf Holdings advisory board
item.description: Former minister Maliki Osman and Revolut chairman Martin Gilbert joined the advisory board of Asia Gulf Holdings, parent of Singapore Gulf Bank.

item.title: COE supply for 3-month period until Jan 2027 to go up by 1.1%
item.description: Certificates available for bidding for Nov 2026–Jan 2027 rise 1% to 19,298, with Category B up 3.3% while Category A stays unchanged.

item.title: A security vulnerability has been detected in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro 7.6.1
item.description: A remote, publicly disclosed CVSS 8.5 vulnerability in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro 7.6.1 allows CRLF injection via the rent_time argument; the vendor did not respond.

item.title: The focus on AI safety disasters ignores everyday harms
item.description: An essay argues tech debate focuses on catastrophic harms while everyday damage, like dependence on AI companions and engagement-driven feeds, gets little attention.

item.title: This Texas startup is turning oil well waste into EV batteries
item.description: Houston-based startup Element3 is filtering lithium from Permian Basin oil wastewater to create a domestic source of the mineral for EV batteries.

item.title: Gheist Uses Stolen GitHub Tokens to Steal Private Repository Secrets via Actions Logs
item.description: A campaign using stolen GitHub tokens plants workflows that print repository secrets into Actions logs, which attackers download before deleting the runs.

item.title: AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available
item.description: AWS's Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available, testing findings for exploitability and opening patch pull requests.

item.title: Loqui
item.description: Loqui turns speech into ready-to-send text in any Mac app, in a tone you pick, and also transcribes meetings and writes minutes.

item.title: affaan-m/ECC: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first…
item.description: ECC is an open-source performance optimization system for AI agent harnesses, offering skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It has 289,194 GitHub stars. Why it matters: Covers tooling for coding agents across several platforms, with a large and fast-growing following on GitHub.

item.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili…
item.description: Agent-Reach is a single CLI that gives AI agents read and search access to platforms like Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu, with no API fees. It has 102,832 GitHub stars. Why it matters: Touches AI models and AI agents.

item.title: Letting AI take software from requirements all the way to launch: will development organizations have to change?
t3dotgg/tstack: The agent skills I use every day. Works with Claude Code and Codex
item.description: The agent skills I use every day, cleaned up so anyone can use them. They work. in Claude Code and Codex.

item.title: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM…
item.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, targeting LLM coding pitfalls Andrej Karpathy observed, such as unchecked assumptions and overcomplicated code.

item.title: alchaincyf/huashu-design: HTML-native design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor & any agent
item.description: Huashu Design. > 「打字。回车。一份能交付的设计。」. > "Type. A finished design lands in your lap.". 在你的 agent 里打一句话，拿回一份能交付的设计。.

item.title: NVIDIA/SkillSpector: Security scanner for AI agent skills. Detect vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, security risks, prompt…
item.description: NVIDIA's SkillSpector is a security scanner for AI agent skills, checking for vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, prompt injection and data exfiltration before install.

item.title: KillaBoi/StealMyBitcoin-PoC: A public release of the Steal My Bitcoin challenge
item.description: A single-file Python proof of concept reproducing the request sequence of a Steal My Bitcoin CTF solve, run against a local Docker lab.

item.title: heydeer/pngdeer: Lossy PNG compression that picks the quality for each image. Command line and browser, same bytes
item.description: Lossy PNG compression that picks the quality for each image. The command line and the browser run the same Rust code and write the same bytes.
